family_assignment: Emitter rows carry explicit audit-family assignments; the AST test only guards source identity drift.

declared_surface.repair_surface: The route and/or template metadata on the finding.
declared_surface.repair_rationale: The message identifies a broken declared relationship and the metadata points to the owning source.
declared_surface.uncertainty: Static analysis cannot prove dynamic request data or browser behavior.

rule_specific_detail.repair_surface: The rule-specific declaration or configuration named in details.
rule_specific_detail.repair_rationale: The rule author supplied a concrete alternative, discovered value, or source location beyond the stable message.
rule_specific_detail.uncertainty: Static analysis cannot prove dynamic request data or browser behavior.

self_describing_configuration.repair_surface: The explicitly named application registration, middleware, or configuration subject in the message.
self_describing_configuration.repair_rationale: These emitters have no route/template metadata or detail because the stable message itself names the exact setting or registration to change.
self_describing_configuration.uncertainty: Static analysis cannot prove runtime values supplied outside the compiled application.

contextual_static_evidence.repair_surface: The template or content construct named by the warning.
contextual_static_evidence.repair_rationale: The warning intentionally requests human content/design review rather than claiming a runtime failure or a single mandatory implementation.
contextual_static_evidence.uncertainty: Static source evidence cannot prove user intent, accessible name quality, or browser behavior.

redacted_plugin_wrapper.repair_surface: The registered custom check named in the finding.
redacted_plugin_wrapper.repair_rationale: The wrapper preserves the check identity and exception type while details explain the local repair path without exposing exception text.
redacted_plugin_wrapper.uncertainty: The original exception text is deliberately unavailable in shared contract output.

dynamic_category.repair_surface: The dynamic category expression and its owning rule source in the emitter id.
dynamic_category.repair_rationale: The source expression is retained verbatim so dynamic category selection is auditable without pretending it is a fixed literal.
dynamic_category.uncertainty: The selected category depends on compiled application inputs and static analysis cannot predict every runtime value.
